method.local_range: pixel centers in spherical 7000m radius disk; longitude wraps; NaN contaminates neighbourhood
method.bathymetry: negative heights excluded from slope/relief only, not elevation means; affected neighborhoods unknown instead of ocean-floor relief
method.aggregation: 6x6 arithmetic finite mean statistics; mountain_count/36 >=0.5 on canonical source land, then approved hilly rule
method.class7: not implemented: <=25km2 enclosed-area fill; class1-6 result is lower bound

hilly.authority: explicit user-approved game rule, 2026-10-02; not a published scientific class
hilly.rule: canonical non-mountain source land with finite relief_mean_m >=100m
hilly.priority: mountains > hilly > ecological crosswalk; non-land unknown
hilly.relief_statistic: finite mean of 36 native pixel-centred 7km elevation ranges
hilly.non_mountain_evidence: mountain_fraction <0.5 and landform_complete_fraction ==1; missing evidence never implies non-mountain

method.highlands: game ecological label for RESOLVE montane grasslands/shrublands, not elevation-derived plateau classifier
method.unknown: unknown ecological region remains neutral unless independently supported mountain or hilly override; no plains fallback
limitations: Ecological regions, not observed contemporary land cover.
Coarse 60s DEM smooths relief versus original mountain mapping.
Spherical distances/Horn derivatives are discretization choices, not exact geodesic reprojection.
No class7 enclosure fill; hilly is a user game rule, not a scientific class.
Negative terrestrial depressions are conservatively excluded from slope/relief together with bathymetry.
Cell counts are not equal-area surface area.

canonical_land_source.encoding: delta; raw south-up indices flipped exactly once

terrain.biome_selection: modal per-cell classification; ties lowest canonical biome ID; unknown participates
terrain.measure_aggregation: arithmetic mean of finite per-cell input measures; counts retain missing coverage; no province homogeneity claim

subdivision.boundary_authority: Explicitly user-approved generated gameplay boundaries, NOT real administrative subdivisions
subdivision.graph: 4-neighbor; longitude wraps; no polar wrap; original parent state/country envelope
subdivision.distance: Shortest-path integer metres: radius6371008.8m, 180/height meridional steps, row-center cosine-scaled 360/width zonal steps; nearest metre, minimum1
subdivision.seeding: First lowest component cell, then maximum minimum graph distance to prior seeds; ties lowest north-down cell ID
subdivision.growth: Distance-ordered connected flood over unassigned same-state cells, cap128; distance/cell heap order; no RNG
subdivision.residuals: Preserved as small connected gameplay provinces, never discarded or merged across state/country boundaries
subdivision.state_identity: All original5509 state IDs/names/countries retained; disconnected components share their immutable state
subdivision.area_limit: Source cells are not equal-area; generated boundaries are not Admin2 geography or exact ellipsoidal geodesics
subdivision.save_compatibility: New province PNG/hierarchy identity; prior opted-in saves require their backed-up matching old inputs; no silent remap
